displayPattern: Amber LED on a Bryant 80% two-stage variable-speed furnace (troubleshooting guide TG-GFB80-02). Short flashes are the first digit and long flashes are the second. Code 22 is 2 short and 2 long
meaning: Abnormal flame-proving signal. Flame is proved while the gas valve is de-energized. The inducer runs until the fault clears. The chart says to check for a leaky gas valve or a stuck-open gas valve.
diySteps: Count 2 short flashes and 2 long flashes. Leave the furnace off if you smell gas
Technician: inspect the gas valve. The inducer is supposed to keep running until this fault clears
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician immediately. Do not reset this and leave the furnace running.
sourceTitle: Bryant 80% variable-speed two-stage furnace troubleshooting guide (Catalog No. TG-GFB80-02)
